name: Oxylabs MCP
description: Lets AI agents scrape any URL with JavaScript rendering and geo-targeting, pull Google and Amazon results, and crawl sites with AI extraction, via the official Oxylabs MCP server.

skills.name: Universal Scraper
skills.description: Scrapes any URL with optional JavaScript rendering and geo-targeting, returning Markdown, HTML, or extracted links.

skills.name: Google Search Scraper
skills.description: Extracts Google Search results for a query, with optional parsing of the results page into structured JSON.

skills.name: Amazon Scrapers
skills.description: Scrapes Amazon search result pages and individual product pages, with optional parsing into structured JSON.

skills.name: AI Crawler
skills.description: Crawls a website from a starting URL based on a prompt and collects the requested data across multiple pages.

skills.name: AI Browser Agent
skills.description: Controls a real browser from a prompt, navigating, clicking, and filling forms, then returns the result of the task.
